await (async page => {const out=[];await page.setViewportSize({width:1440,height:1000});await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Show filters',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('spinbutton',{name:'Your Age'}).fill('18');await page.getByRole('combobox',{name:'Location'}).selectOption({label:'United States'});await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Breast',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Interventional',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Phase 2',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Search Trials →',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText(/End of results/).waitFor({timeout:45000});out.push({flow:'age18-US-BREAST-interventional-phase2-all-statuses',ids:await page.locator('a[href^="https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/"]').evaluateAll(es=>es.map(e=>e.href.match(/NCT\d{8}/)[0]))});await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Show filters',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('spinbutton',{name:'Your Age'}).fill('0');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Search Trials →',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText('No trials found',{exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:45000});out.push({flow:'empty-infant-combined-filters',statusRole:await page.getByRole('status').innerText()});await page.goto('http://localhost:8788');await page.route('**/api/v2/studies**',route=>route.fulfill({status:200,contentType:'application/json',body:'{}'}));await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Search Trials →',exact:true}).click();await page.getByRole('alert').waitFor();out.push({flow:'malformed-upstream',alert:await page.getByRole('alert').innerText(),cards:await page.locator('a[href^="https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/"]').count()});await page.unroute('**/api/v2/studies**');await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Try again',exact:true}).click();await page.getByText(/End of results/).waitFor({timeout:45000});out.push({flow:'retry-live-registry',cards:await page.locator('a[href^="https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/"]').count()});return out;})(page);
